name: DiLuigi Foods
old_description: Want to know the secret behind delicious food? Well, you start by taking half-century old recipes, mix in bold innovation, and top that off with good, honest quality. Yeah, it’s different, but we’re proud of that. We take gratification in selecting and accepting only the highest quality beef, chicken, and steak meat products for our customers. We offer various retail and wholesale opportunities.
about:
Founded in 1950 in Danvers, Massachusetts, DiLuigi Foods remains a family-owned operation that has linked tradition with innovation for over seven decades. The company began as a provider of quality meats and has grown into a recognized food manufacturing business serving retail and foodservice channels.

DiLuigi Foods processes beef, chicken, and steak products through SQF-certified facilities. The company maintains an in-house laboratory for rapid raw-material testing and coordinates third-party verification to ensure food safety. A dedicated culinary R&D team develops new products and flavors, conducting extensive taste, texture, color, packaging, and shelf-life testing before market release. Operations span retail and wholesale distribution, with a focus on minimally processed, high-quality meat items.

The company serves retail grocery, foodservice distributors, and restaurant operators. Its product development cycle explicitly reviews restaurant, retail, and foodservice trends to create items that perform in the marketplace. Customers include both retail buyers seeking branded meat products and foodservice operators requiring consistent quality and innovation.

DiLuigi Foods emphasizes its commitment to food safety and quality as its founding principle. The ownership cites the in-house lab, third-party audits, and SQF certification as key differentiators that allow faster, more accurate quality evaluation. Community involvement, including support for local food banks and national philanthropic efforts, is also noted as part of the company's mission since 1950.
